name: io.github.AKzar1el/mcp-gsc
title: Google Search Console
description: Google Search Console MCP for analytics, indexing, sitemaps, and SEO diagnostics.

tools.name: server.capabilities
tools.description: List every tool this server exposes and report whether your Google connection is currently authenticated.

tools.name: sites.list
tools.description: List the Search Console properties the connected Google account can access.

tools.name: sites.get
tools.description: Get one exact Search Console property and the connected account's permission level for it.

tools.name: analytics.query
tools.description: Impressions, clicks, CTR, and average position over a date range. Google can return only top rows and does not guarantee every data row.

tools.name: insights.page_queries
tools.description: For one exact page URL, list the Search Console queries that produced impressions for it.

tools.name: insights.query_pages
tools.description: For one exact search query, list the site pages that received impressions for it.

tools.name: urls.inspect
tools.description: Google's URL Inspection report for the indexed version of a single page: index status, last crawl, page-fetch/indexing state, canonicals, and rich-results/AMP analysis where available. Not a live URL test; mobile usability is deprecated. Use urls.inspect_many for 2-10 URLs.

tools.name: urls.inspect_many
tools.description: Inspect Google's indexed versions of up to 10 URLs sequentially while preserving one URL Inspection quota unit per URL. This does not run live URL tests.

tools.name: sitemaps.list
tools.description: All sitemaps submitted for a property, with status and warning/error counts.

tools.name: sites.add
tools.description: Add a new website property to your Google Search Console account.

tools.name: sites.delete
tools.description: Remove an existing website property from your Google Search Console account.

tools.name: sitemaps.submit
tools.description: Submit a new sitemap to your Google Search Console account.

tools.name: sitemaps.delete
tools.description: Remove a submitted sitemap from your Google Search Console account.

tools.name: sitemaps.get
tools.description: Get status and details of a single sitemap submitted to Google Search Console.

tools.name: insights.quick_wins
tools.description: Find high-impression query/page rows whose Search Console average position falls in the configured opportunity range. Average position is not a literal current rank, and CTR is context rather than an eligibility filter.

tools.name: insights.cannibalization
tools.description: Analyze search analytics to find queries for which multiple pages compete for visibility.

tools.name: insights.content_decay
tools.description: Compare two contiguous periods to find pages with the largest search-click declines.

tools.name: indexing.request
tools.description: Request Google to index or update an eligible URL using the Google Indexing API.

tools.name: indexing.list_pages
tools.description: List pages with Search Console impressions. This is performance data, not an index-coverage inventory; use URL Inspection for URL-level index status.

tools.name: analytics.compare
tools.description: Compare clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position between two date ranges by query, page, country, or device.

tools.name: reports.weekly_digest
tools.description: Generate a plain-language weekly SEO report with movers, top pages, and a recommended action.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local HTTP port used by the npm launcher.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth client ID for the local Worker.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth client secret for the local Worker.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key used to encrypt stored Google refresh tokens.
